findings.surface: global shell › sidebar › Projects tree (all routes, initial load)
findings.inventoryRow: Global shell, desktop sidebar, phone navigation drawer, top bar
evidence: S/walk/l4-states/load-_app.png (sidebar under PROJECTS reads 'No projects yet' while main reads 'Loading your dashboard…')
S/walk/l4-states/load-_projects_project_launch.png (same sidebar text while 'Loading project…'; the seed has four projects)
repro: 2. delay every /api/** request by ~8 s (page.route + fallback)
4. look at the sidebar during the wait
findings.expected: While the project list is being fetched, the sidebar communicates that it is loading, not that the workspace is empty.
findings.actual: The sidebar shows the empty-workspace message 'No projects yet' for the whole wait, then replaces it with four projects. A user with projects is told, falsely, that they have none.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status

findings.surface: dashboard /app; sidebar Projects tree; project workspace 'Project unavailable'; Task List, Progress, Reflections, Timeline section bodies; /settings/agents
evidence: S/walk/l4-states/err-me-500.png (dashboard: only a red box with the literal server text 'Simulated failure from auditor'; same text repeated in the sidebar under PROJECTS)
S/walk/l4-states/err-proj-500.png (heading 'Project unavailable' + alert with raw server text, no action)
S/walk/l4-states/003-err-sectiondata-full.png and ARIA of the canvas (four section bodies each show only the raw message)
S/walk/l4-states/err-dash-projects-500.png (sidebar shows raw text in small red type)
S/walk/l4-states/err-agents-500.png (AI & Agents: raw text, empty list, no retry)
Contrast: root Todos and Reflections pages show the same raw text but with a 'Try again' button (todos-500, refl-500 ARIA); Settings uses 'Retry list', Archive 'Retry archive read'
S/walk/l4-states/err-picker-500.png (Add a shortcut dialog: raw text, no retry)
repro: 2. route GET /api/me (or /api/projects/project-launch, /api/tasks?…, /api/reflections?…, /api/projects/*/timeline, /api/projects/*/progress) to a 500 with body {error:'internal_error', message:'Simulated failure from auditor'}
findings.expected: A failed read says in product language what could not be loaded, whether anything the user sees is stale, and offers a way to try again without a full page reload.
findings.actual: Dashboard, sidebar, project page, canvas sections and the agents page print the server's message string verbatim inside a red box, name nothing about what failed, and offer no retry; the dashboard and sidebar show the identical string twice on one screen. Sibling surfaces do offer recovery, under three different labels ('Try again' on root pages, 'Retry list' in Settings, 'Retry archive read' on Archive), so whether a failure is recoverable depends on where it happens.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #9 Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

findings.surface: project workspace › Home canvas › Task List, Reflections, Timeline sections
evidence: S/walk/l4-states/003-err-sectiondata-full.png (Task List: red 'Simulated failure…' box directly above 'No tasks yet. Add the first one above.')
ARIA: Reflections region = alert + 'No reflections yet.'; Timeline region = alert + 'No dated work yet.'
findings.expected: When a section cannot read its content, it does not also claim the content is empty; the user can tell 'failed to load' from 'nothing here'.
findings.actual: Each section renders the error and the empty-state sentence at the same time. Task List invites 'Add the first one above' although the list has three tasks, and the add form and reflection composer stay fully enabled.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status; internal consistency

findings.surface: project workspace › Task List › add task form
evidence: S/walk/l4-states/pend-addtask.png (0.7 s after clicking Add task with a 5 s delayed POST: draft still in the field, Add task button enabled and unchanged, no placeholder row, no spinner)
S/walk/l4/out-addtask.json (ARIA during: button 'Add task' not disabled, no status text; after: task appears and the detail drawer opens)
repro: 4. type a title in 'Add a task' and click Add task
findings.expected: After submitting, the user can see that the task is being added and that pressing again is not needed.
findings.actual: Nothing changes for the duration of the write: the field keeps the text and the button stays live, so the screen looks as if the click did not register (inviting a second submit). Completion, by contrast, shows an optimistic checked-and-disabled checkbox, so the two writes in the same section behave differently.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status

findings.surface: project workspace › Task List › error banner after failed add/complete; /settings/agents permission checkboxes

S/walk/l4/out-addtask-fail.json, out-complete-fail.json (identical alert text for both failures)

findings.surface: project workspace › Task List › overdue row vs. error alert; dashboard Today overdue row

findings.surface: project workspace of an archived project (archived workstream project-legacy; archived root project-renovation) › canvas, Task List, section dialog

repro: 3. click 'Add a section', keep Markdown, click Create
4. (root) archive Cabinets, Kitchen, Garden then Home renovation via More › Archive; on Home type a task and click Add task
findings.expected: An archived project reads as archived at a glance, does not invite edits it will refuse, and tells the user in plain words how to bring it back if they want to change it.
findings.actual: The archived page looks identical to a live one apart from the word 'Archived' in the header metadata. Every write control is enabled; each one fails after the user commits, with a message that quotes the internal project id and says 'reactivate it first' — a verb that matches no control on the page (the More menu shows plain status buttons; the root's Archive page sends the user to Settings instead). Renaming the archived workstream, by contrast, succeeds, so what is and is not allowed is unpredictable.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #5 Error prevention; Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status
